title: SnapshotIndex
description: The top-level pointer object of the public snapshot (`index.json`). The backend writes everything else under a content-addressed `snapshots/<snapshotId>/` prefix first, then overwrites this single small object last — that overwrite is the atomic cut-over. The site reads this, then follows it to the versioned prefix.

snapshotId.description: A timestamp+hash identifying this snapshot, used as the prefix so a new snapshot never clobbers the previous one until this pointer is swapped.

runsKey.description: Key of the run index (runs.json) within this snapshot.

runsPrefix.description: Key prefix the per-run record files live under.

casesPrefix.description: Key prefix the per-case-version metadata files live under.
